objective_value: <float> Total expected supply chain cost represented by the complete submitted witness.
model_variables: <dict, key: canonical variable name> Sparse complete witness; omitted variables are zero. Keys must use Gurobi bracket syntax exactly as specified by model_variable_name_patterns.
y: <dict, key: 'y_{module_size_id}_{unit_id}'> Whether each candidate manufacturing unit of a given size is purchased and placed into service (1 = selected, 0 = not selected).

model_variable_name_patterns.x[i,j,t,s]: demand site i, production site j, period t, scenario s
model_variable_name_patterns.w[j,jp,m,t,s]: relocation between distinct production sites j and jp
